pr.title: docs(conport): reconcile docs to real MCP surface and freeze out-of-scope schema tables
pr.body:
Reconciles ConPort documentation to match the actual 13-tool MCP surface finalized by TPs 104-106:

1. Rewrites `.claude/modules/cognitive-plane/conport-memory.md` to document the real 13-tool surface only — removes any tools not present in tools/list after TP-106.
2. Creates `docs/systems/conport/TRINITY_BOUNDS.md` documenting ConPort non-goals per the Memory Trinity ADR (session_snapshots, adhd_metrics, and decision_patterns belong in dope-memory, not ConPort).
3. Updates `docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/SURFACE_INVENTORY.md` to reflect current tools and remove stale entries.
4. Updates `docs/systems/conport/surface-equivalence-and-drift.md` to reflect current state.
5. Adds `-- FROZEN: belongs in dope-memory per Memory Trinity ADR` comments to session_snapshots, adhd_metrics, and decision_patterns table definitions in schema.sql.

Depends on DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-104, 105, 106 (tool surface must be finalized).

steps.task: Preflight worktree. Read the current conport-memory.md, SURFACE_INVENTORY.md, surface-equivalence-and-drift.md, and schema.sql. Query tools/list from live container (or read from TP-106 proof) to get the authoritative 13-tool list.
validation: 13-tool list confirmed from tools/list or TP-106 proof and recorded in proof.
Stale tool references in conport-memory.md identified and listed.
session_snapshots, adhd_metrics, decision_patterns table definitions located in schema.sql by direct read.

steps.task: Rewrite .claude/modules/cognitive-plane/conport-memory.md to enumerate only the real 13 tools with accurate parameter descriptions. Remove any tools, capabilities, or endpoints that do not exist in the current surface. Mark UNKNOWN where status is unclear.
validation: conport-memory.md references exactly 13 tools — count confirmed by grep.
No tool name in conport-memory.md fails to appear in the tools/list proof.
UNKNOWN markers used for any capability whose status was not directly verified.

steps.task: Create docs/systems/conport/TRINITY_BOUNDS.md documenting ConPort non-goals per Memory Trinity ADR: session_snapshots, adhd_metrics, and decision_patterns belong in dope-memory. Document what ConPort IS responsible for (decisions, progress, context, patterns, custom_data, search, relationships).
validation: TRINITY_BOUNDS.md exists and is non-empty.
File explicitly lists session_snapshots, adhd_metrics, decision_patterns as dope-memory scope.
File explicitly lists ConPort's in-scope capabilities.

steps.task: Add FROZEN comments to schema.sql: insert '-- FROZEN: belongs in dope-memory per Memory Trinity ADR' on the line immediately before each of the session_snapshots, adhd_metrics, and decision_patterns CREATE TABLE statements. Update SURFACE_INVENTORY.md and surface-equivalence-and-drift.md to remove stale tool entries.
validation: grep -c 'FROZEN: belongs in dope-memory' schema.sql returns 3.
SURFACE_INVENTORY.md tool list matches the 13-tool proof.
surface-equivalence-and-drift.md reflects current drift status.

steps.task: Add a relationship-vocabulary reconciliation section to TRINITY_BOUNDS.md (or as a standalone doc/systems/conport/relationship-vocab-reconciliation.md if TRINITY_BOUNDS.md is already complete). The section MUST include a table documenting that the two relationship vocabularies are INTENTIONALLY DISTINCT and must NOT be merged: entity_relationships vocab = {builds_upon, validates, extends, implements, depends_on, supersedes} (6 terms, all cross-type entity edges); decision_relationships vocab = {builds_upon, supersedes, conflicts_with, validates, implements, questions} (6 terms, decision-to-decision semantic links). The table must call out the 3 shared terms (builds_upon, validates, implements) and note they carry the same surface meaning but operate on different subject types. The section must explicitly state: 'These vocabularies are intentionally separate by ADR-conport-hardening-scope-and-trinity-boundaries D3. Do not merge them.'
validation: Relationship vocabulary reconciliation table is present in TRINITY_BOUNDS.md or the dedicated vocab doc.
Table lists all 6 terms of entity_relationships vocab and all 6 terms of decision_relationships vocab.
3 shared terms (builds_upon, validates, implements) are explicitly called out.
Text explicitly states the split is intentional per ADR-D3 and must not be merged.
No merger of the two vocabularies is performed or implied by any other change in this packet.
